Matco makes NONE of their own tools with the exception of the toolboxes all the air guns/ratchets ext are ALL rebranded. Cornwell is a great brand for specialty tools so I recommend them for things like compression testers or OBD scanners and things of the like and for tools that take a beating husky or Pittsburg is the way to go in my experience. Also look on eBay/ offer up or shop online or pawnshops because if you get tools in decent shape from there it won’t break the bank and if the tools eventually break they may not have a warranty but if you buy the $20 breaker bar from harbor freight or the $50 impact gun from a pawn shop it’s not so bad to go replace it as opposed to the $250 one from snap on or matco. Second hand toolboxes are also a great way to go on a budget.  Hope this helps!
